notes:
Mitsubishi cars on the diagnostic socket's CAN pair (11-bit identifiers, 500 kbit/s): Outlander PHEV (2013 onwards), and the i-MiEV with its badge-engineered twins, the Citroen C-Zero and Peugeot iOn. The i-MiEV family rows come from OVMS (0x761, 0x765, 0x771, 0x782); the Outlander PHEV rows come from OBDb. The units at 0x761 and 0x765 are in both sets, so they are the best supported.

Every address is a fact transcribed from open diagnostic-tool sources; no signal definition is copied. Treat every row as unconfirmed until `obd-read probe` shows the unit answering.

The identifiers are not the legislated ones and the response offset varies: 1 for most (0x761 to 0x762, 0x765 to 0x766, 0x771 to 0x772), but 0x600 answers at 0x500, 0x688 at 0x511 and 0x6A0 at 0x514. Each unit names its own response identifier.

Units are read with service 21 (local identifier, one byte) in the sources, so the profile carries KWP2000; the unit at 0x743 is read with service 22 in OBDb and carries UDS.

A profile takes one response per request identifier. OBDb also has 0x600 answering at 0x601 (keyless reads) and 0x688 answering at 0x689, which are not listed because those request identifiers already name a unit above; and the 29-bit unit at header DA15 is not listed because a profile has one identifier width.

A Nissan secure gateway from 2020 does not apply here, but the vendor handout that lists it says nothing about Mitsubishi; a unit that stays silent is reported as no response.

Session caveat: no source shows a Mitsubishi unit accepting the session this profile opens. The OVMS and OBDb Mitsubishi sources open no session and send the service 21 read directly, so session 0x81 (KWP2000) and 0x01 (UDS) are only guard-permitted placeholders and are unconfirmed; confirming the session on a real car is tracked in https://github.com/Mearman/obd/issues/70.

vin.source: The WMIs are the makers' car and SUV identifiers in the world manufacturer identifier table of the Wikipedia article Vehicle identification number, which cites the Kraftfahrt-Bundesamt manufacturer list SV 3.2 (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vehicle_identification_number, archived https://web.archive.org/web/20261102120229/https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vehicle_identification_number). A WMI names the maker and plant, not the model, so a match only says the car is of a make this profile covers.
